newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR SAYS FORECASTS DIVERGE FROM CO VIEW.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR SAYS FORECASTS DIVERGE FROM CO VIEW.

text.p: Finnish food and sweetener group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Wednesday that analysts' forecasts for its January-April earnings in a Reuters poll were not in line with what it has said about its profit development.
The poll of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 101 million markka median forecast profit before extraordinary items, up from 49 million markka in the year-ago period.

"The forecast is not in line with what the company has said about its profit development," Cultor said, referring to CEO Bjorn Mattson's comments to shareholders on April 11 that the performance in the first tertial was at the year-ago level.
It said the full-year forecast given in the annual report was still valid.
"We expect the Group's performance to improve during 1997 and the result to be close to that achieved in 1995," Cultor said in its annual report.
In 1995, Cultor posted a 494 million markka profit after financial items and last year's profit was 391 million markka.
